text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In a huge upset, Mejiro McQueen<n>does not take
her third consecutive<n>victory. Rice Shower emerges
victorious instead.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Hearing the words of congratulations<n>from her fans
and friends, Rice<n>Shower is overcome with emotion
as<n>she realizes she has made them all<n>smile.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Before the winning concert, Mejiro<n>McQueen gives
her an encouraging<n>push forward.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She heads to the stage, set on<n>expressing her
gratitude to the fans<n>who supported her.
